name: lodestar
description: Lodestar — your compass for life: capture every open question, prioritize what matters, and never lose one. SQLite-backed so nothing is lost.

scripts.test-brain: BOARD_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 BRAIN_CHROMA_URL=http://localhost:8004 BRAIN_CHROMA_DATABASE=lodestar-test uv run --project brain --extra local-embeddings uvicorn lodestar_brain.server:app --port 9001
scripts.raglab: uv run --project brain --extra semantic --extra local-embeddings --with 'ragas==0.4.*' --with 'langchain-community<0.4' --with 'langchain-openai<1' --with rapidfuzz uvicorn --app-dir brain/tests raglab.server:app --port 9002
scripts.raglab:inspector: uv run --project brain --extra semantic --extra local-embeddings uvicorn --app-dir brain/tests raglab.inspector:app --port 9003
scripts.raglab:sweep: PYTHONPATH=brain/tests uv run --project brain --extra semantic --extra local-embeddings --with 'ragas==0.4.*' --with 'langchain-community<0.4' --with 'langchain-openai<1' --with rapidfuzz python -m raglab.sweep
scripts.raglab:judgescreen: PYTHONPATH=brain/tests uv run --project brain python -m raglab.judgescreen
scripts.raglab:leaderboard: PYTHONPATH=brain/tests uv run --project brain python -m raglab.leaderboard
scripts.test:all: node scripts/backup-db.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.js && uv run --project brain pytest brain/tests -v && uv run --with playwright python tests/e2e_test.py
